definitions.explanation: One part out of ten. Japan uses the 割 system where one 割 equals 10%, alongside the percentage system.

examples.japanese: {売上|うりあげ}の{一割|いちわり}が{利益|りえき}だ。
examples.english: One tenth of the sales is profit.

examples.japanese: {参加者|さんかしゃ}のうち{一割|いちわり}が{外国人|がいこくじん}だった。
examples.english: About 10% of the participants were foreigners.

examples.japanese: {定価|ていか}から{一割|いちわり}{引|び}きで{購入|こうにゅう}できるクーポンを{使|つか}った。
examples.english: I used a coupon that let me buy it at a 10% discount from the regular price.

notes:
The {割|わり} system is Japan's traditional way of expressing fractions and percentages. {一割|いちわり} = 10%, {二割|にわり} = 20%, etc. Below {一割|いちわり}, the scale continues with {分|ぶ} (1%) and {厘|りん} (0.1%).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一割|いちわり}{引|び}き — 10% discount
- {一割|いちわり}{増|ぞう} — 10% increase
- {一割|いちわり}{負担|ふたん} — 10% co-payment (especially in healthcare)
- {約|やく}{一割|いちわり} — about 10%

THE {割|わり} SYSTEM:
- {一割|いちわり} = 10%
- {三割|さんわり} = 30%
- {五割|ごわり} = 50% (half)
- {三割五分|さんわりごぶ} = 35% (used especially in baseball batting averages)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- 10パーセント — 10 percent (Western-style; also common)
- {十分|じゅうぶん}の{一|いち} — one tenth (fraction form)

CULTURAL NOTE:
The {割|わり} system is used commonly in daily life for discounts ({二割引|にわりびき} = 20% off), medical co-payments ({三割負担|さんわりふたん} = 30% co-pay), and baseball statistics ({打率|だりつ}{三割|さんわり} = .300 batting average).
